conditional_branch: register T2/FLAIR to T1c only if not already co-registered
conditional_registration: register_to_reference is deliberately NOT a required stage: BraTS-style inputs arrive already co-registered at 1x1x1 mm, so a correct plan skips it. Scoring keys off the segmentation/feature/grade/report stages, which are mandatory regardless of input geometry.
feature_dependency: ROI features require a segmentation; the rule-based grade consumes those features
grade_rule: Whole-tumor feature volume threshold with texture fallback; confidence is code-derived, not calibrated clinical probability.

report_consumption.caution: A correctly skipped conditional registration can appear missing in generic report stage_status; this is not task failure.
report_consumption.model_boundary: Brain defaults llm_mode to server and may attempt structured report/image QC through configured adapter; separate from deterministic report JSON. No model or adapter was executed.
report_consumption.reads: case_state records, identify_sequences mapping, optional registration record, brats_mri_segmentation success, extract_roi_features result/CSV previews, ROI WT/TC/ET volumes and optional structured image QC
report_consumption.report_json: case/run/domain, sequence mapping, feature path, stage status (including optional registration), brain_assessment segmentation flag and WT/TC/ET volumes; not grade truth

segmentation_fallback: MONAI bundle preferred; heuristic fallback only when dependency check fails. Threshold WT<=32 voxels can be replaced by an ellipsoid, so nonempty mask is not anatomical validation.
